bounded_host_request.command: docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT r.room_id,substring(r.request_key from '[0-9]+$') AS request_revision, d.revision AS draft_revision,d.step AS draft_step,d.data->>'stage' AS stage,d.data->>'modeSelected' AS mode_selected,d.data->>'selectedTopicId' AS selected_topic,a.announcement_id FROM room_posts r LEFT JOIN public_post_drafts d ON d.owner_user_id=r.owner_user_id AND d.module='room' LEFT JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.room_id=r.room_id WHERE r.updated_at>=now()-interval '48 hours' ORDER BY r.room_id" && docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT to_regclass('public.room_join_links') IS NOT NULL AS room_links_table_exists, (SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE enabled=true AND feature in ('room','announcement')) AS enabled_release_gates"
